---
title: "Tile-size observations"
engine: knitr
---

Nominal tile size comes from recorded standard run IDs; it is not a new
measurement of tile footprints. Run strata are not pooled. A causal tile-size
comparison requires controlled coverage/density/tool/core/storage and matching
input preparation, not just two filenames with different sizes.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
source("R/reporting.R")
benchmark_report_page("tile_size")
```
